edges.reason: msg.sender is captured as owner and tax wallet during construction, determining all privileged access.
Constructor assigns the deployer to _taxWallet.
Constructor mints the fixed _tTotal supply to the contract.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist before allowing transfers.
_transfer can trigger swapTokensForEth when swap is enabled.
_transfer can forward ETH to the fee wallet when threshold is reached.
_transfer finalizes balances through _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer performs SafeMath sub/add updates on balances, relevant to arithmetic correctness.
_tokenTransfer applies _taxFee multiplication/division for tax computation.
swapTokensForEth relies on the _inSwap lock flag to prevent reentrant swaps.
swapTokensForEth calls into the router stored in _uniswap.
External router swap occurs while state (balances) is being processed, a reentrancy-relevant external call.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the tax wallet, an external value call.
manualSend has no onlyOwner modifier and lets anyone trigger sendETHToFee with the full contract balance.
createUniswapPair calls the factory to create the pair.
The created pair address is stored in _pair.
createUniswapPair approves the pair for maximum spending.
addLiquidity performs an external payable liquidity call to the router.
addLiquidity enables automatic swaps by setting _swapEnabled.
startTrading flips the _canTrade flag.
increaseBuyLimit (onlyOwner) overwrites the transaction limit.
increaseMaxWallet (onlyOwner) overwrites the wallet limit.
blockBots (onlyOwner) writes into the bots blacklist mapping.
unblockBot writes false into the bots mapping.
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) clears the ownership state variable.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
msg.sender indirectly becomes the from address in _transfer via transfer.
The transferFrom sender argument is forwarded to _transfer.
The transfer amount argument flows into _transfer.
_transfer forwards its from/amount arguments into _tokenTransfer arithmetic.
tAmount is multiplied by taxRate to compute tTeam.
tTeam is subtracted from tAmount to derive tTransferAmount.
tokenAmount is used alongside the local path array for the router swap.
The bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping.
notbot is written into the bots mapping.
The amount argument of sendETHToFee is the value sent via .transfer to the tax wallet.
The amount argument of increaseBuyLimit is written to _maxTxAmount.
The amount argument of increaseMaxWallet is written to _maxWallet.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient argument of transfer only feeds the core transfer flow and carries no independent semantics.
Amount argument of transfer is a transient input to the core transfer function.
Sender argument of transferFrom is a transient input to the core transferFrom function.
From address argument is local plumbing into the core _transfer routine.
To address argument is local plumbing into the core _transfer routine.
Amount argument is local plumbing into the core _transfer routine.
Sender argument of _tokenTransfer is a transient internal input.
Recipient argument of _tokenTransfer is a transient internal input.
tAmount is the primary arithmetic input of the core _tokenTransfer function.
taxRate drives the tax arithmetic inside the core _tokenTransfer function.
tTeam is a derived local of _tokenTransfer with no independent state meaning.
tTransferAmount is a derived local of _tokenTransfer with no independent state meaning.
tokenAmount feeds the core swapTokensForEth operation.
path is a local array constructed for the core swapTokensForEth call.
The amount argument only parameterizes the core increaseBuyLimit function.
The amount argument only parameterizes the core sendETHToFee value transfer.
bots_ is the iteration input of the core blockBots function.
notbot is the single input of the core unblockBot function.
The amount argument only parameterizes the core increaseMaxWallet function.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local used by the core _transfer swap logic.
contractETHBalance is a transient local feeding the core manualSend ETH forwarding path.
